meta.name: frontend-design
meta.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, or applications. Generates creative, polished code that avoids generic AI aesthetics.

copy.tagline: 构建高质量前端界面与组件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成美观、可投产的前端代码
copy.tagline_en: Build production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate beautiful, production-ready frontend code

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会根据你的需求生成前端界面代码（HTML/CSS/JS、React、Vue 等），注重独特的美学风格，避免千篇一律的 AI 设计。
howto.when: 当你要求构建网页组件、页面或应用时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个复古未来风格的登录页面。
say.note: Claude 会生成带有独特字体和动画的登录页代码。

say.text: 做一个极简主义的个人博客首页。
say.note: Claude 会产出注重留白和排版精度的博客页面。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates frontend interface code (HTML/CSS/JS, React, Vue, etc.) based on your requirements, focusing on distinctive aesthetics and avoiding generic AI designs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to build web components, pages, or applications.

say_en.text: Design a retro-futuristic login page for me.
say_en.note: Claude will generate login page code with unique fonts and animations.

say_en.text: Create a minimalist personal blog homepage.
